title: Generic backlog export row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/handoff/backlog_export_generic.csv produced by bsa-backlog-bridge (Phase 3, US-S9-03). The 'paste-into-our-home-grown-tool' format — minimal CSV with the columns most likely to be useful: Title, Description, AcceptanceCriteria, Priority, plus full BSA provenance (StoryID, SourceClaimIDs, RelatedNFRIDs, INVESTStatus, A51Ref). No platform-specific fields (Status, Estimate, Labels) — those are tool-specific overlays. Read-only with respect to canonical state. Schema-enforced via F5 dispatcher entry under analysis/handoff/backlog_export_generic.csv.

Description.description: Sourced from A70.StoryText (the canonical 'As a <persona>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>' shape).

AcceptanceCriteria.description: Sourced from A70.AcceptanceCriteria verbatim. Whatever separator A70 used (semicolon, newline) carries through unchanged so the consumer's tooling can re-split as it sees fit.

Priority.description: Verbatim from A70.Priority — generic format does NOT translate to platform-specific tiers; consumers map however they like.

StoryID.description: Verbatim A70.StoryID. Required for drift detection.

SourceClaimIDs.description: Verbatim A70.SourceClaimIDs. Empty allowed when RelatedNFRIDs is non-empty.

INVESTStatus.description: Verbatim A70.INVESTStatus. Lets the consumer surface deferred items in their own backlog UI.

A51Ref.description: Verbatim A70.A51Ref. Required (non-empty) when INVESTStatus != 'pass' — same coupling as A70 enforces; the bridge preserves the linkage for the consumer.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability + idempotency.

x-bsa-provenance-rules._comment: INV-08 carries through to the export — every row MUST carry non-empty SourceClaimIDs OR RelatedNFRIDs (mirrors A70 schema's same-named extension). Reuses the generalized _apply_provenance_rules handler in write_validator.py.
x-bsa-provenance-rules.rationale: An export row with both provenance fields empty would be a backlog item the consumer can't trace back to a claim or NFR — defeats the whole point of the bridge. Schema-enforced at write time.

x-bsa-invest-rules._comment: INVESTStatus ↔ A51Ref coupling carries through to the export. INVESTStatus != 'pass' MUST co-populate A51Ref (mirrors A70 schema's same-named extension). Reuses the generalized _apply_invest_rules handler in write_validator.py.
x-bsa-invest-rules.rationale: A deferred backlog item without an A51 route is silently abandoned work. The bridge preserves the A70-level coupling so the consumer's import retains the deferred-decision linkage.
